verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ καθεξῆς καὶ αὐτὸς διώδευεν κατὰ πόλιν καὶ κώμην κηρύσσων καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ οἱ δώδεκα σὺν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō kathexēs kai autos diōdeuen kata polin kai kōmēn kēryssōn kai euangelizomenos tēn basileian tou Theou kai hoi dōdeka syn autō
verses.literal: Soon afterward Jesus traveled from one town and village to another preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God The Twelve were with Him
verses.literalPt: Logo depois, andava Jesus pelas cidades e aldeias, pregando e anunciando as boas-novas do reino de Deus, e iam com ele os doze

verses.original: καὶ γυναῖκές τινες αἳ ἦσαν τεθεραπευμέναι ἀπὸ πνευμάτων πονηρῶν καὶ ἀσθενειῶν Μαρία ἡ καλουμένη Μαγδαληνή ἀφ’ ἧς δαιμόνια ἑπτὰ ἐξεληλύθει
verses.transliteration: kai gynaikes tines hai ēsan tetherapeumenai apo pneumatōn ponērōn kai astheneiōn Maria hē kaloumenē Magdalēnē aph’ hēs daimonia hepta exelēlythei
verses.literal: as well as some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities Mary called Magdalene from whom seven demons had gone out
verses.literalPt: e algumas mulheres que haviam sido curadas de espíritos malignos e de enfermidades: Maria, chamada Madalena, da qual tinham saído sete demônios;

verses.original: καὶ Ἰωάννα γυνὴ Χουζᾶ ἐπιτρόπου Ἡρῴδου καὶ Σουσάννα καὶ ἕτεραι πολλαί αἵτινες διηκόνουν αὐτοῖς ἐκ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐταῖς
verses.transliteration: kai Iōanna gynē Chouza epitropou Hērōdou kai Sousanna kai heterai pollai haitines diēkonoun autois ek tōn hyparchontōn autais
verses.literal: Joanna the wife of Herod’s household manager Chuza Susanna and many others These women were ministering to them out of their own means
verses.literalPt: Joana, mulher de Cuza, procurador de Herodes; Susana e muitas outras, as quais lhe assistiam com os seus bens.

verses.original: Συνιόντος δὲ ὄχλου πολλοῦ καὶ τῶν κατὰ πόλιν ἐπιπορευομένων πρὸς αὐτὸν εἶπεν διὰ παραβολῆς
verses.transliteration: Syniontos de ochlou pollou kai tōn kata polin epiporeuomenōn pros auton eipen dia parabolēs
verses.literal: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town He told them this parable
verses.literalPt: Afluindo uma grande multidão e vindo ter com ele gente de todas as cidades, disse Jesus em parábola:

verses.original: Ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων τοῦ σπεῖραι τὸν σπόρον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ σπείρειν αὐτὸν ὃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν καὶ κατεπατήθη καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατέφαγεν αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Exēlthen ho speirōn tou speirai ton sporon autou kai en tō speirein auton ho men epesen para tēn hodon kai katepatēthē kai ta peteina tou ouranou katephagen auto
verses.literal: A farmer went out to sow his seed And as he was sowing some seed fell along the path where it was trampled and the birds of the air devoured it
verses.literalPt: Saiu o semeador para semear a sua semente. Quando semeava, uma parte da semente caiu à beira do caminho; foi pisada, e as aves do céu a comeram.

verses.original: Καὶ ἕτερον κατέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν καὶ φυὲν ἐξηράνθη διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ἰκμάδα
verses.transliteration: Kai heteron katepesen epi tēn petran kai phyen exēranthē dia to mē echein ikmada
verses.literal: Some fell on rocky ground and when it came up the seedlings withered because they had no moisture
verses.literalPt: Outra caiu sobre a pedra; e, tendo crescido, secou, porque não havia umidade.

verses.original: Καὶ ἕτερον ἔπεσεν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀκανθῶν καὶ συμφυεῖσαι αἱ ἄκανθαι ἀπέπνιξαν αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Kai heteron epesen en mesō tōn akanthōn kai symphyeisai hai akanthai apepnixan auto
verses.literal: Other seed fell among thorns - which grew up with it and choked the seedlings
verses.literalPt: Outra caiu no meio dos espinhos com ela cresceram os espinhos, e sufocaram-na.

verses.original: Καὶ ἕτερον ἔπεσεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν καὶ φυὲν ἐποίησεν καρπὸν ἑκατονταπλασίονα Ταῦτα λέγων ἐφώνει Ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω
verses.transliteration: Kai heteron epesen eis tēn gēn tēn agathēn kai phyen epoiēsen karpon hekatontaplasiona Tauta legōn ephōnei Ho echōn ōta akouein akouetō
verses.literal: Still other seed fell on - good soil where it sprang up and produced a crop a hundredfold As Jesus said this He called out He who has ears to hear let him hear
verses.literalPt: Outra caiu na boa terra e, tendo crescido, deu fruto a cento por um. Dizendo isso, clamou: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.

verses.original: Ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ Τίς αὕτη εἴη ἡ παραβολή
verses.transliteration: Epērōtōn de auton hoi mathētai autou Tis hautē eiē hē parabolē
verses.literal: Then His disciples asked Him what this parable meant
verses.literalPt: Seus discípulos perguntaram-lhe o que significava essa parábola.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ὑμῖν δέδοται γνῶναι τὰ μυστήρια τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῖς δὲ λοιποῖς ἐν παραβολαῖς ἵνα Βλέποντες μὴ βλέπωσιν Καὶ ἀκούοντες μὴ συνιῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Hymin dedotai gnōnai ta mystēria tēs basileias tou Theou tois de loipois en parabolais hina Blepontes mē blepōsin Kai akouontes mē syniōsin
verses.literal: He replied The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of God has been given to you but to others I speak in parables so that though seeing they may not see though hearing they may not understand
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: A vós vos é dado conhecer os mistérios do reino de Deus, mas aos outros se lhes fala em parábolas, para que, vendo, não vejam; e, ouvindo, não entendam.

verses.original: Ἔστιν δὲ αὕτη ἡ παραβολή ὁ σπόρος ἐστὶν ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Estin de hautē hē parabolē ho sporos estin ho logos tou Theou
verses.literal: Now this is the meaning of the parable The seed is the word of God
verses.literalPt: O sentido da parábola é este: A semente é a palavra de Deus.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν εἰσιν οἱ ἀκούσαντες εἶτα ἔρχεται ὁ διάβολος καὶ αἴρει τὸν λόγον ἀπὸ τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν ἵνα μὴ πιστεύσαντες σωθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: hoi de para tēn hodon eisin hoi akousantes eita erchetai ho diabolos kai airei ton logon apo tēs kardias autōn hina mē pisteusantes sōthōsin
verses.literal: The seeds along the path are those who hear but the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts so that they may not believe and be saved
verses.literalPt: Os que estão à beira do caminho são os que têm ouvido; então, vem o Diabo e tira a palavra dos seus corações, para que não suceda que, crendo, sejam salvos.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἐπὶ τῆς πέτρας οἳ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν μετὰ χαρᾶς δέχονται τὸν λόγον καὶ οὗτοι ῥίζαν οὐκ ἔχουσιν οἳ πρὸς καιρὸν πιστεύουσιν καὶ ἐν καιρῷ πειρασμοῦ ἀφίστανται
verses.transliteration: Hoi de epi tēs petras hoi hotan akousōsin meta charas dechontai ton logon kai houtoi rhizan ouk echousin hoi pros kairon pisteuousin kai en kairō peirasmou aphistantai
verses.literal: The seeds on rocky ground are those who hear the word and receive it with joy but they have no root They believe for a season but in the time of testing they fall away
verses.literalPt: Os que estão sobre a pedra são os que, depois de ouvirem, recebem a palavra com gozo; estes não têm raiz e creem por algum tempo, mas, na hora de provação, voltam atrás.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας πεσόν οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀκούσαντες καὶ ὑπὸ μεριμνῶν καὶ πλούτου καὶ ἡδονῶν τοῦ βίου πορευόμενοι συμπνίγονται καὶ οὐ τελεσφοροῦσιν
verses.transliteration: To de eis tas akanthas peson houtoi eisin hoi akousantes kai hypo merimnōn kai ploutou kai hēdonōn tou biou poreuomenoi sympnigontai kai ou telesphorousin
verses.literal: The seeds that fell among the thorns are those who hear but as they go on their way they are choked by the worries riches and pleasures of this life and their fruit does not mature
verses.literalPt: A parte que caiu entre os espinhos, estes são os que ouviram e, indo seu caminho, são sufocados pelos cuidados, riquezas e deleites da vida, e o seu fruto não amadurece.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ ἐν τῇ καλῇ γῇ οὗτοί εἰσιν οἵτινες ἐν καρδίᾳ καλῇ καὶ ἀγαθῇ ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον κατέχουσιν καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἐν ὑπομονῇ
verses.transliteration: To de en tē kalē gē houtoi eisin hoitines en kardia kalē kai agathē akousantes ton logon katechousin kai karpophorousin en hypomonē
verses.literal: But the seeds on good soil are those with a noble and good heart who hear the word cling to it and by persevering produce a crop
verses.literalPt: A que caiu na boa terra, estes são os que, tendo ouvido a palavra com coração reto e bom, a retêm e dão fruto com perseverança.

verses.original: Οὐδεὶς δὲ λύχνον ἅψας καλύπτει αὐτὸν σκεύει ἢ ὑποκάτω κλίνης τίθησιν ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ λυχνίας τίθησιν ἵνα οἱ εἰσπορευόμενοι βλέπωσιν τὸ φῶς
verses.transliteration: Oudeis de lychnon hapsas kalyptei auton skeuei ē hypokatō klinēs tithēsin all’ epi lychnias tithēsin hina hoi eisporeuomenoi blepōsin to phōs
verses.literal: No one lights a lamp and covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed Instead he sets it on a stand so those who enter can see the light
verses.literalPt: Ninguém, depois de acender uma candeia, a cobre com um vaso ou a põe debaixo duma cama; pelo contrário, coloca-a sobre um velador, a fim de que os que entram vejam a luz.

verses.original: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ φανερὸν γενήσεται οὐδὲ ἀπόκρυφον ὃ οὐ μὴ γνωσθῇ καὶ εἰς φανερὸν ἔλθῃ
verses.transliteration: ou gar estin krypton ho ou phaneron genēsetai oude apokryphon ho ou mē gnōsthē kai eis phaneron elthē
verses.literal: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed and nothing concealed that will not be made known and brought to light
verses.literalPt: Pois não há coisa oculta, que não venha a ser manifesta; nem coisa secreta, que se não haja de saber e vir à luz.

verses.original: Βλέπετε οὖν πῶς ἀκούετε ὃς ἂν γὰρ ἔχῃ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ ἔχῃ καὶ ὃ δοκεῖ ἔχειν ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Blepete oun pōs akouete hos an gar echē dothēsetai autō kai hos an mē echē kai ho dokei echein arthēsetai ap’ autou
verses.literal: Pay attention therefore to how you listen Whoever . . . has will be given more but whoever . . . does not have even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him
verses.literalPt: Vede, pois, como ouvis; porque ao que tiver, ser-lhe-á dado; e ao que não tiver, até aquilo que pensa ter ser-lhe-á tirado.

verses.original: Παρεγένετο δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο συντυχεῖν αὐτῷ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον
verses.transliteration: Paregeneto de pros auton hē mētēr kai hoi adelphoi autou kai ouk ēdynanto syntychein autō dia ton ochlon
verses.literal: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see Him but they were unable to reach Him because of the crowd
verses.literalPt: Vieram ter com ele sua mãe e seus irmãos e não podiam aproximar-se dele por causa da multidão.

verses.original: ἀπηγγέλη δὲ αὐτῷ Ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ἑστήκασιν ἔξω ἰδεῖν θέλοντές σε
verses.transliteration: apēngelē de autō Hē mētēr sou kai hoi adelphoi sou hestēkasin exō idein thelontes se
verses.literal: He was told . . . Your mother and - brothers are standing outside wanting to see You
verses.literalPt: Foi-lhe dito: Tua mãe e teus irmãos estão lá fora e desejam ver-te.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Μήτηρ μου καὶ ἀδελφοί μου οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀκούοντες καὶ ποιοῦντες
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen pros autous Mētēr mou kai adelphoi mou houtoi eisin hoi ton logon tou Theou akouontes kai poiountes
verses.literal: But He replied . . . . . . . . . My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, respondeu: Minha mãe e meus irmãos são aqueles que ouvem a palavra de Deus e a observam.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐνέβη εἰς πλοῖον καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Διέλθωμεν εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς λίμνης καὶ ἀνήχθησαν
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en mia tōn hēmerōn kai autos enebē eis ploion kai hoi mathētai autou kai eipen pros autous Dielthōmen eis to peran tēs limnēs kai anēchthēsan
verses.literal: One day Jesus said to His disciples Let us cross to the other side of the lake So He got into . . . a boat with them and set out
verses.literalPt: Num daqueles dias, entrou numa barca com seus discípulos e disse-lhes: Atravessemos o lago; e partiram.

verses.original: πλεόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἀφύπνωσεν καὶ κατέβη λαῖλαψ ἀνέμου εἰς τὴν λίμνην καὶ συνεπληροῦντο καὶ ἐκινδύνευον
verses.transliteration: pleontōn de autōn aphypnōsen kai katebē lailaps anemou eis tēn limnēn kai syneplērounto kai ekindyneuon
verses.literal: As they sailed He fell asleep and a windstorm . . . came down on the lake so that the boat was being swamped and they were in great danger
verses.literalPt: Enquanto navegavam, adormeceu. Desceu uma tempestade de vento sobre o lago; a barca começou a encher-se, e eles estavam em perigo.

verses.original: Προσελθόντες δὲ διήγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Ἐπιστάτα ἐπιστάτα ἀπολλύμεθα Ὁ δὲ διεγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ ἀνέμῳ καὶ τῷ κλύδωνι τοῦ ὕδατος καὶ ἐπαύσαντο καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη
verses.transliteration: Proselthontes de diēgeiran auton legontes Epistata epistata apollymetha Ho de diegertheis epetimēsen tō anemō kai tō klydōni tou hydatos kai epausanto kai egeneto galēnē
verses.literal: The disciples went and woke Him saying Master Master we are perishing Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters and they subsided and all was calm
verses.literalPt: Aproximando-se, despertaram-no, dizendo: Mestre, Mestre, perecemos. Despertado, repreendeu o vento e a fúria da água; eles cessaram, e houve bonança.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ποῦ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν Φοβηθέντες δὲ ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες πρὸς ἀλλήλους Τίς ἄρα οὗτός ἐστιν ὅτι καὶ τοῖς ἀνέμοις ἐπιτάσσει καὶ τῷ ὕδατι καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autois Pou hē pistis hymōn Phobēthentes de ethaumasan legontes pros allēlous Tis ara houtos estin hoti kai tois anemois epitassei kai tō hydati kai hypakouousin autō
verses.literal: Where is your faith He asked - Frightened and amazed they asked one another Who is this He commands even the winds and the water and they obey Him
verses.literalPt: Então, lhes perguntou: Onde está a vossa fé? Eles, aterrorizados, se maravilharam, dizendo uns aos outros: Quem, porventura, é este que manda aos ventos e à água, e eles lhe obedecem?

verses.original: Καὶ κατέπλευσαν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γερασηνῶν ἥτις ἐστὶν ἀντιπέρα τῆς Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: Kai katepleusan eis tēn chōran tōn Gerasēnōn hētis estin antipera tēs Galilaias
verses.literal: Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes across the lake from Galilee
verses.literalPt: Aportaram à terra dos gerasenos, que é fronteira à Galileia.

verses.original: ἐξελθόντι δὲ αὐτῷ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὑπήντησεν ἀνήρ τις ἐκ τῆς πόλεως ἔχων δαιμόνια καὶ χρόνῳ ἱκανῷ οὐκ ἐνεδύσατο ἱμάτιον καὶ ἐν οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔμενεν ἀλλ’ ἐν τοῖς μνήμασιν
verses.transliteration: exelthonti de autō epi tēn gēn hypēntēsen anēr tis ek tēs poleōs echōn daimonia kai chronō hikanō ouk enedysato himation kai en oikia ouk emenen all’ en tois mnēmasin
verses.literal: When Jesus stepped ashore He was met by a demon-possessed man from the town For a long time this man had not worn clothing or lived in a house but he stayed in the tombs
verses.literalPt: Depois de haver ele desembarcado, veio da cidade ao seu encontro um homem possesso de demônios que havia muito tempo não vestia roupa e não habitava em casa alguma, mas nos túmulos.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀνακράξας προσέπεσεν αὐτῷ καὶ φωνῇ μεγάλῃ εἶπεν Τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί Ἰησοῦ Υἱὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Ὑψίστου δέομαί σου μή με βασανίσῃς
verses.transliteration: Idōn de ton Iēsoun anakraxas prosepesen autō kai phōnē megalē eipen Ti emoi kai soi Iēsou Huie tou Theou tou Hypsistou deomai sou mē me basanisēs
verses.literal: When the man saw Jesus he cried out and fell down before Him shouting in a loud voice . . . What do You want with me Jesus Son of the Most High God I beg You not to torture me
verses.literalPt: Ele, vendo a Jesus, gritou, caiu-lhe aos pés e disse em alta voz: Que tenho eu contigo, Jesus, Filho do Deus Altíssimo? Rogo-te que não me atormentes.

verses.original: παρήγγελλεν γὰρ τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ ἐξελθεῖν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πολλοῖς γὰρ χρόνοις συνηρπάκει αὐτόν καὶ ἐδεσμεύετο ἁλύσεσιν καὶ πέδαις φυλασσόμενος καὶ διαρρήσσων τὰ δεσμὰ ἠλαύνετο ὑπὸ τοῦ δαιμονίου εἰς τὰς ἐρήμους
verses.transliteration: parēngellen gar tō pneumati tō akathartō exelthein apo tou anthrōpou pollois gar chronois synērpakei auton kai edesmeueto halysesin kai pedais phylassomenos kai diarrēssōn ta desma ēlauneto hypo tou daimoniou eis tas erēmous
verses.literal: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man Many times it had seized him and though he was bound with chains and shackles he had broken the chains and been driven by the demon into solitary places
verses.literalPt: Pois Jesus ordenara ao espírito imundo que saísse do homem. Muitas vezes, se apoderara dele; o homem era posto sob guarda e preso com algemas e grilhões, mas ele, partindo as cadeias, era impelido pelo demônio para os desertos.

verses.original: Ἐπηρώτησεν δὲ αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τί σοι ὄνομά ἐστιν ὁ Δὲ εἶπεν Λεγιών ὅτι εἰσῆλθεν δαιμόνια πολλὰ εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Epērōtēsen de auton ho Iēsous Ti soi onoma estin ho De eipen Legiōn hoti eisēlthen daimonia polla eis auton
verses.literal: What is your name - Jesus asked Legion - he replied because many demons had gone into him
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhe Jesus: Qual é o teu nome? Respondeu ele: Legião, porque eram muitos os demônios que nele haviam entrado.

verses.original: καὶ παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν ἵνα μὴ ἐπιτάξῃ αὐτοῖς εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον ἀπελθεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai parekaloun auton hina mē epitaxē autois eis tēn abysson apelthein
verses.literal: And the demons kept begging Jesus not to order them to go into the Abyss
verses.literalPt: Estes lhe suplicaram que não os mandasse ir para o abismo.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ ἀγέλη χοίρων ἱκανῶν βοσκομένη ἐν τῷ ὄρει καὶ παρεκάλεσαν αὐτὸν ἵνα ἐπιτρέψῃ αὐτοῖς εἰς ἐκείνους εἰσελθεῖν καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Ēn de ekei agelē choirōn hikanōn boskomenē en tō orei kai parekalesan auton hina epitrepsē autois eis ekeinous eiselthein kai epetrepsen autois
verses.literal: There on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding So the demons begged Jesus to let them enter . . . the pigs and He gave them permission . . .
verses.literalPt: Havia ali uma grande manada de porcos pastando no monte; e pediram-lhe que lhes permitisse passar para eles.

verses.original: Ἐξελθόντα δὲ τὰ δαιμόνια ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰσῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους καὶ ὥρμησεν ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν λίμνην καὶ ἀπεπνίγη
verses.transliteration: Exelthonta de ta daimonia apo tou anthrōpou eisēlthon eis tous choirous kai hōrmēsen hē agelē kata tou krēmnou eis tēn limnēn kai apepnigē
verses.literal: Then the demons came out of the man and went into the pigs and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned
verses.literalPt: E foi-lhes permitido. Os demônios, tendo saído do homem, entraram nos porcos; a manada precipitou-se pelo declive no lago e afogou-se.

verses.original: Ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ βόσκοντες τὸ γεγονὸς ἔφυγον καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εἰς τοὺς ἀγρούς
verses.transliteration: Idontes de hoi boskontes to gegonos ephygon kai apēngeilan eis tēn polin kai eis tous agrous
verses.literal: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened they ran off and reported this in the town and - countryside
verses.literalPt: Quando os pastores viram o que havia acontecido, fugiram e foram contá-lo na cidade e nos campos.

verses.original: ἐξῆλθον δὲ ἰδεῖν τὸ γεγονὸς καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ εὗρον καθήμενον τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἀφ’ οὗ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐξῆλθεν ἱματισμένον καὶ σωφρονοῦντα παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν
verses.transliteration: exēlthon de idein to gegonos kai ēlthon pros ton Iēsoun kai heuron kathēmenon ton anthrōpon aph’ hou ta daimonia exēlthen himatismenon kai sōphronounta para tous podas tou Iēsou kai ephobēthēsan
verses.literal: So the people went out to see what had happened They came to Jesus and found the man whom the demons had left . . . sitting at Jesus’ feet clothed and in his right mind and they were afraid
verses.literalPt: Então, saiu o povo para ver o que se tinha passado; e foram ter com Jesus, a cujos pés encontraram, sentado, vestido e em perfeito juízo, o homem do qual tinham saído os demônios; e ficaram com medo.

verses.original: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ αὐτοῖς οἱ ἰδόντες πῶς ἐσώθη ὁ δαιμονισθείς
verses.transliteration: apēngeilan de autois hoi idontes pōs esōthē ho daimonistheis
verses.literal: Meanwhile those who had seen it reported . . . how the demon-possessed man had been healed
verses.literalPt: Os que o haviam visto contaram-lhes de que modo se realizara a cura do endemoninhado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἠρώτησεν αὐτὸν ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος τῆς περιχώρου τῶν Γερασηνῶν ἀπελθεῖν ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ὅτι φόβῳ μεγάλῳ συνείχοντο αὐτὸς δὲ ἐμβὰς εἰς πλοῖον ὑπέστρεψεν
verses.transliteration: Kai ērōtēsen auton hapan to plēthos tēs perichōrou tōn Gerasēnōn apelthein ap’ autōn hoti phobō megalō syneichonto autos de embas eis ploion hypestrepsen
verses.literal: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to depart from them because great fear had taken hold of them So He got into the boat and started back
verses.literalPt: Todo o povo da terra dos gerasenos rogou-lhe que se retirasse deles, pois estavam possuídos de grande medo; Jesus entrou na barca e voltou.

verses.original: Ἐδεῖτο δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀνὴρ ἀφ’ οὗ ἐξεληλύθει τὰ δαιμόνια εἶναι σὺν αὐτῷ ἀπέλυσεν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγων
verses.transliteration: Edeito de autou ho anēr aph’ hou exelēlythei ta daimonia einai syn autō apelysen de auton legōn
verses.literal: The man whom the demons had left . . . begged to go with Jesus But He sent him away . . . saying
verses.literalPt: Mas o homem de quem tinham saído os demônios, suplicava-lhe que o deixasse acompanhá-lo. Jesus, porém, despediu-o, dizendo:

verses.original: Ὑπόστρεφε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου καὶ διηγοῦ ὅσα σοι ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεός καὶ ἀπῆλθεν καθ’ ὅλην τὴν πόλιν κηρύσσων ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: Hypostrephe eis ton oikon sou kai diēgou hosa soi epoiēsen ho Theos kai apēlthen kath’ holēn tēn polin kēryssōn hosa epoiēsen autō ho Iēsous
verses.literal: Return home and describe how much God has done for you So the man went away and proclaimed all over the town how much Jesus had done for him
verses.literalPt: Volta para tua casa e conta tudo o que Deus te fez. O homem partiu, publicando por toda a cidade tudo o que lhe fizera Jesus.

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑποστρέφειν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπεδέξατο αὐτὸν ὁ ὄχλος ἦσαν γὰρ πάντες προσδοκῶντες αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: En de tō hypostrephein ton Iēsoun apedexato auton ho ochlos ēsan gar pantes prosdokōntes auton
verses.literal: When Jesus returned the crowd welcomed Him for they had all been waiting for Him
verses.literalPt: Quando regressou, foi Jesus bem recebido pelo povo, pois todos o esperavam.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἦλθεν ἀνὴρ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰάϊρος καὶ οὗτος ἄρχων τῆς συναγωγῆς ὑπῆρχεν καὶ πεσὼν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai idou ēlthen anēr hō onoma Iairos kai houtos archōn tēs synagōgēs hypērchen kai pesōn para tous podas tou Iēsou parekalei auton eiselthein eis ton oikon autou
verses.literal: Just then . . . a synagogue leader named Jairus - - came and fell at Jesus’ feet He begged Him to come to his house
verses.literalPt: Veio um homem chamado Jairo, que era chefe da sinagoga, e, prostrando-se aos pés de Jesus, suplicou-lhe que chegasse à sua casa,

verses.original: ὅτι θυγάτηρ μονογενὴς ἦν αὐτῷ ὡς ἐτῶν δώδεκα καὶ αὐτὴ ἀπέθνῃσκεν Ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑπάγειν αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι συνέπνιγον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: hoti thygatēr monogenēs ēn autō hōs etōn dōdeka kai autē apethnēsken En de tō hypagein auton hoi ochloi synepnigon auton
verses.literal: because his . . . only daughter who was about twelve . . . - was dying As Jesus went with him the crowds pressed around Him
verses.literalPt: porque tinha uma filha única, de cerca de doze anos, que estava à morte. Enquanto ele ia, a multidão o apertava.

verses.original: καὶ γυνὴ οὖσα ἐν ῥύσει αἵματος ἀπὸ ἐτῶν δώδεκα ἥτις ἰατροῖς προσαναλώσασα ὅλον τὸν βίον οὐκ ἴσχυσεν ἀπ’ οὐδενὸς θεραπευθῆναι
verses.transliteration: kai gynē ousa en rhysei haimatos apo etōn dōdeka hētis iatrois prosanalōsasa holon ton bion ouk ischysen ap’ oudenos therapeuthēnai
verses.literal: including a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years She had spent all her money on physicians but no one was able to heal her
verses.literalPt: Uma mulher que, por doze anos, estava padecendo de uma hemorragia e a quem ninguém podia curar,

verses.original: προσελθοῦσα ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ καὶ παραχρῆμα ἔστη ἡ ῥύσις τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: proselthousa opisthen hēpsato tou kraspedou tou himatiou autou kai parachrēma estē hē rhysis tou haimatos autēs
verses.literal: She came up behind Jesus and touched the fringe of His cloak and immediately her bleeding stopped
verses.literalPt: chegando-se por detrás, tocou-lhe a fímbria da capa; e, imediatamente, cessou a sua hemorragia.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τίς ὁ ἁψάμενός μου Ἀρνουμένων δὲ πάντων εἶπεν ὁ Πέτρος Ἐπιστάτα οἱ ὄχλοι συνέχουσίν σε καὶ ἀποθλίβουσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen ho Iēsous Tis ho hapsamenos mou Arnoumenōn de pantōn eipen ho Petros Epistata hoi ochloi synechousin se kai apothlibousin
verses.literal: Who touched Me - Jesus asked But they all denied it Master said Peter the people are crowding and pressing against You
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Jesus: Quem é o que me tocou? Negando-o todos, disse Pedro: Mestre, a multidão te aperta e te oprime.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἥψατό μού τις ἐγὼ γὰρ ἔγνων δύναμιν ἐξεληλυθυῖαν ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen Hēpsato mou tis egō gar egnōn dynamin exelēlythuian ap’ emou
verses.literal: But Jesus declared Someone touched Me for I know that power has gone out from Me
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus disse: Alguém me tocou, porque eu percebi que saíra de mim uma virtude.

verses.original: Ἰδοῦσα δὲ ἡ γυνὴ ὅτι οὐκ ἔλαθεν τρέμουσα ἦλθεν καὶ προσπεσοῦσα αὐτῷ δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν ἥψατο αὐτοῦ ἀπήγγειλεν ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ὡς ἰάθη παραχρῆμα
verses.transliteration: Idousa de hē gynē hoti ouk elathen tremousa ēlthen kai prospesousa autō di’ hēn aitian hēpsato autou apēngeilen enōpion pantos tou laou kai hōs iathē parachrēma
verses.literal: Then the woman seeing that she could not escape notice came trembling and fell down before Him In the presence of all the people she explained why she had touched Him and how she had immediately been healed . . .
verses.literalPt: A mulher, vendo-se percebida, veio, tremendo, prostrar-se diante dele e declarou, na presença de todo o povo, o motivo por que o havia tocado e como fora imediatamente curada.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Θυγάτηρ ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε πορεύου εἰς εἰρήνην
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autē Thygatēr hē pistis sou sesōken se poreuou eis eirēnēn
verses.literal: Daughter - said Jesus . . . your faith has healed you Go in peace
verses.literalPt: Ele lhe disse: Filha, a tua fé te curou; vai-te em paz.

verses.original: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἔρχεταί τις παρὰ τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου λέγων ὅτι Τέθνηκεν ἡ θυγάτηρ σου μηκέτι σκύλλε τὸν Διδάσκαλον
verses.transliteration: Eti autou lalountos erchetai tis para tou archisynagōgou legōn hoti Tethnēken hē thygatēr sou mēketi skylle ton Didaskalon
verses.literal: While He was still speaking someone arrived from the house of the synagogue leader Your daughter is dead he told Jairus Do not bother the Teacher anymore
verses.literalPt: Quando ele ainda falava, veio uma pessoa da casa do chefe da sinagoga, dizendo a este: Tua filha morreu, não incomodes mais o Mestre.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀκούσας ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Μὴ φοβοῦ μόνον πίστευσον καὶ σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous akousas apekrithē autō Mē phobou monon pisteuson kai sōthēsetai
verses.literal: But Jesus overheard them and said to Jairus Do not be afraid just believe and she will be healed
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo isso, disse-lhe Jesus: Não temas; crê somente, e ela será salva.

verses.original: Ἐλθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν οὐκ ἀφῆκεν εἰσελθεῖν τινα σὺν αὐτῷ εἰ μὴ Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν πατέρα τῆς παιδὸς καὶ τὴν μητέρα
verses.transliteration: Elthōn de eis tēn oikian ouk aphēken eiselthein tina syn autō ei mē Petron kai Iōannēn kai Iakōbon kai ton patera tēs paidos kai tēn mētera
verses.literal: When He entered . . . the house He did not allow anyone to go in with Him except . . . Peter John James and the child’s father and mother
verses.literalPt: Tendo chegado à casa, não permitiu que ninguém entrasse com ele, senão Pedro, João, Tiago e o pai e a mãe da menina.

verses.original: ἔκλαιον δὲ πάντες καὶ ἐκόπτοντο αὐτήν ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Μὴ κλαίετε οὐ γὰρ ἀπέθανεν ἀλλὰ καθεύδει
verses.transliteration: eklaion de pantes kai ekoptonto autēn ho de eipen Mē klaiete ou gar apethanen alla katheudei
verses.literal: Meanwhile everyone was weeping and mourning for her But Jesus said Stop weeping she is not dead but asleep
verses.literalPt: Todos choravam e a pranteavam. Mas ele disse: Não choreis; ela não está morta, mas sim dormindo.

verses.original: Καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: Kai kategelōn autou eidotes hoti apethanen
verses.literal: And they laughed at Him knowing that she was dead
verses.literalPt: Riam-se dele, porque sabiam que ela estava morta.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς ἐφώνησεν λέγων Ἡ Παῖς ἔγειρε
verses.transliteration: Autos de kratēsas tēs cheiros autēs ephōnēsen legōn HĒ Pais egeire
verses.literal: But Jesus took her by the hand and called out . . . Child get up
verses.literalPt: Porém ele, tomando-a pela mão, disse em voz alta: Menina, levanta-te.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῆς καὶ ἀνέστη παραχρῆμα καὶ διέταξεν αὐτῇ δοθῆναι φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai epestrepsen to pneuma autēs kai anestē parachrēma kai dietaxen autē dothēnai phagein
verses.literal: Her spirit returned and at once she got up And He directed that she be given something to eat
verses.literalPt: Voltou o seu espírito, e ela se levantou imediatamente; e ele mandou que lhe dessem a ela de comer.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτῆς ὁ δὲ παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς μηδενὶ εἰπεῖν τὸ γεγονός
verses.transliteration: kai exestēsan hoi goneis autēs ho de parēngeilen autois mēdeni eipein to gegonos
verses.literal: Her parents were astounded but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened
verses.literalPt: Seus pais encheram-se de pasmo; e ele lhes advertiu que a ninguém contassem o que havia acontecido.
